hints.title: Prefix Interval Decomposition
hints.text: The number of times digit d occurs in [low, high] equals count(high) - count(low - 1), where count(n) tallies occurrences in [1, n].

hints.title: Place Value Contribution
hints.text: Count digit d separately at each positional weight m = 1, 10, 100, ... using quotient n // (m * 10), current digit (n // m) % 10, and remainder n % m.

hints.title: Zero Digit Edge Case
hints.text: When d is 0, numbers cannot have leading zeros. Adjust the higher-part multiplier by subtracting one full period to exclude invalid leading zero representations.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through all numbers from low to high takes O((high - low) * log(high)), which times out for ranges up to 10^8.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting by positional place values computes occurrences in O(log N) arithmetic operations with constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert range query to prefix difference and count digit occurrences place by place.
complexity.notes: Place value arithmetic operates in O(log10(N)) steps.
